<html><head/><body><p>When enabled, try to reduce flickering or other motion effects. This can potentially impact performance.</p></body></html>
<html><head/><body><p>Wrap a sheet of lens tissue around the lens housing. This will prevent you from getting fingerprints onto any of the glass surfaces.</p><p>Remove the silicone Aperture Nozzle.</p></body></html>

<p align="center" style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2'; font-size:10pt; font-weight:600;">LightBurn, by LightBurn Software</span></p></body></html>
<p align="center" style="-qt-paragraph-type:empty; margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px; font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2'; font-size:8.25pt;"><br /></p>
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2'; font-size:10pt; font-weight:600; text-decoration: underline;">Hotkeys and Gestures:</span></p>
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2'; font-size:8.25pt;">
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2'; font-size:8.25pt;"> </span></p>
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2'; font-size:8.25pt;">- Esc
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2'; font-weight:600; text-decoration: underline;">General Usage Notes</span></p>
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2'; font-weight:600; text-decoration: underline;">Keyboard</span></p>
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2'; font-weight:600; text-decoration: underline;">Mouse</span></p>
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2'; font-weight:600;">Note: </span><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';">if the edit window has the keyboard focus, the keys L, R, T, B will align left, right, top, and bottom, C aligns vertical centers, E aligns horizontal centers, P moves the selection to page center, and H and V are horizontal and vertical flip.</span></p>
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';">
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';">- Align:
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';">- Delete:
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';">- Drag mods:</span><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2'; font-size:8.25pt;">
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';">- Drag:
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';">- Mirror:
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';">- Move:
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';">- Redo:
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';">- Selection:
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';">- Undo:
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';">- View drag:
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';">- Zoom in:
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';">- Zoom out:
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';">- Zoom:
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';">Hold ctrl when clicking the &quot;Offset&quot; tool button to use the last known settings and skip the interactive dialog.</span></p></body></html>
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';">Hold ctrl when importing to use arc-fit simplification on the importing file.</span></p>
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';">Hold shift when importing to place them according to their original file.</span></p>
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';">If you don't know what a button / option does, hover the mouse over it.  Tooltip help is almost always added to things to explain them better.</span></p>
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';">If you need to reset your device connection, simply open the devices menu, and select OK.  LightBurn does a full disconnect / reconnect cycle when you click ok in the devices menu.</span></p>
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';">If you've never run LightBurn, the first thing you need to do is set up a device type in the devices box (we'll take you there next).  If you have more than one type of device, you can add more than one and choose a default. Many features of LightBurn are modified depending on the device you have selected, so this is a necessary first step.</span></p>
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';">Imported graphics are placed in the center of the view by default, or if dragged into view, wherever they are dropped.</span></p>
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';">Most feature hotkeys can be found next to the action in the menus.  Nearly everything is added to both menus and toolbars to make it easier to use, but also to make the hotkeys for things visible.</span></p>
<p style=" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';">The toolbars and windows can all be dragged around if you don't like the layout.  Whatever you end up with is saved when you quit.</span></p>
<p style=" margin-top:12px; margin-bottom:12px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2'; font-size:8.25pt;">To configure settings manually, skip the import and click next.<br />To Import existing EZCad configuration follow these steps: </span></p>
<p style=" margin-top:12px; margin-bottom:12px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2'; font-size:8.25pt;">To configure settings manually, skip the import and click next.<br />To Import existing EZCad3 configuration: </span></p>
<p style=" margin-top:12px; margin-bottom:12px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2'; font-size:8.25pt;">To configure settings manually, skip the import and click next.<br />To Import existing SEACad configuration follow these steps: </span></p>
<p style="-qt-paragraph-type:empty; margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px; font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2'; font-size:8.25pt;"><br /></p>
<p style="-qt-paragraph-type:empty; margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px; font-family:'MS Shell Dlg 2';"><br /></p>

= nmlProd > stretchCutoff ? clamp(stretchBase * (1.0 / stretchFrac), 0.0, 1.0) : clamp(stretchBase * (1.0 / (1.0 - stretchFrac)), 0.0, 1.0);
= nmlProd > stretchCutoff ? nmlProd - stretchCutoff : nmlProd;
= nmlProd > stretchCutoff ? nmlStretch : 1.0 - nmlStretch;
= nmlProd > stretchCutoff ? warmColor.rgb : coolColor.rgb;
= nmlStretch > 0.0 && expBase > 1.0 ? (pow(expBase, nmlExp) - 1.0) / (expBase - 1.0) : nmlExp;
= stretchCutoff > 0.5 ? stretchCutoff : 1.0 - stretchCutoff;
= vec3(BASE_COLOR.r * 0.15, BASE_COLOR.g * 0.15, BASE_COLOR.b * 0.15);
= vec4(red, green, blue, 1.0);
= ~w
